description.zh: 清理被取代的组件并减少组件存储的大小。
description.en: Use it to clean up the superseded components and reduce the size of the component store.

warning_override.zh: 清理后将无法卸载更新，如果有卸载更新需求请勿使用此选项。
warning_override.en: The installed Windows Updates cannot be uninstalled after the operation is completed.

warning_override.zh: 清理后将无法卸载更新，此外ResetBase模式跟系统重置功能有冲突，如果有卸载更新或者系统重置需求请勿使用此选项。
warning_override.en: Updates cannot be uninstalled after cleaning up. In addition, ResetBase mode conflicts with system reset function. Please do not use this option if you have such needs.

warning_override.zh: 清理后将无法卸载更新，如果有卸载更新需求请勿使用此选项。
warning_override.en: The installed Windows Updates cannot be uninstalled after the operation is completed.

description.zh: 在系统升级或者还原后留下的系统备份。
description.en: This backup is made after upgrading or restoring to a previous backup.

warning.zh: 删除后你将无法回滚到以前安装的系统。
warning.en: You cannot restore to the previous installation should you delete this folder.

description.zh: 360浏览器在升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Backup files created by 360 Web Browser when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

warning.zh: 删除旧版本后会失去对应的回滚文件。请在浏览器更新完成后清理。
warning.en: Removing older versions discards their rollback files. Clean up after browser updates finish.

description.zh: 阿里旺旺在升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Backup files created by AliIM when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

name.zh: Microsoft Edge 旧版本回滚备份

description.zh: 清理 Microsoft Edge 升级后遗留在 Application 目录下的旧版本回滚文件夹，严格保留当前运行版本。
description.en: Removes outdated version folders left by Microsoft Edge updates while preserving the active executable version.

warning.zh: 删除旧版本后会失去对应的回滚文件。请在浏览器更新完成后清理。
warning.en: Removing older versions discards their rollback files. Clean up after browser updates finish.

description.zh: Chrome浏览器升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Previous Backup created by Chrome when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

warning.zh: 删除旧版本后会失去对应的回滚文件。请在浏览器更新完成后清理。
warning.en: Removing older versions discards their rollback files. Clean up after browser updates finish.

description.zh: Opera浏览器升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Previous Backup created by Opera when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

warning.zh: 删除旧版本后会失去对应的回滚文件。请在浏览器更新完成后清理。
warning.en: Removing older versions discards their rollback files. Clean up after browser updates finish.

name.zh: 微信与企业微信更新安装包缓存

description.zh: 清理微信与企业微信版本自动更新后残留的 patch / update / updata 安装包目录，不影响聊天记录与登录状态。
description.en: Clears leftover update packages stored by WeChat and WeCom without affecting chat history or login data.

description.zh: 酷狗音乐在升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Previous Backup created by Kugou Music when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

name.zh: VS Code / Cursor 扩展安装包与编译缓存
name.en: VS Code & Cursor Extension VSIX / Code Cache

description.zh: 清理 Visual Studio Code 与 Cursor 残留的离线 VSIX 扩展安装包及 V8 代码编译缓存（CachedData），不影响已安装插件与配置。
description.en: Clears CachedExtensionVSIXs and CachedData folders for VS Code and Cursor without affecting installed extensions or settings.

description.zh: WPS在升级到新版本后留下的备份文件，在故障时回滚到老版本。
description.en: Previous Backup created by WPS when upgrading to a newer version. This is used to restore to the previous version should the program malfunctions.

description.zh: 此功能将移除所有系统自带Appx应用，移除后可以在Windows应用商店重新下载他们。
description.en: This feature removes all system embedded Appx. You can download them again from the Windows Store.

description.zh: 当程序遇到某些问题时，系统会在这里留下稳定性报告，建议你定期清理。
description.en: Should a program encounter any error, the system will leave a stability report here. It is recommended to clean this directory up regularly.

description.zh: Windows在运行过程中产生的事件。
description.en: Event files created when running various Windows programs.

warning.zh: 删除事件日志会丢失对应的故障排查和审计记录。需要保留时请先导出。
warning.en: Deleting event logs removes their troubleshooting and audit history. Export any records you need to retain.

description.zh: 使用Windows Update安装更新后保存的记录。
description.en: Windows Update keeps a record of your installed updates.

warning.zh: 删除后更新历史记录将被清空。
warning.en: After removing this item, the update history will be cleared.

description.zh: 清理被取代的msp补丁并减少Installer目录的大小。
description.en: Clean replaced msp patches and reduce the size of Installer folder.

warning.zh: (这是一个实验性功能)清理后将无法卸载被取代的msp更新，如果有卸载更新需求请勿使用此选项。
warning.en: (Experimental) After cleaning, replaced msp updates cannot be uninstalled. If you wish to uninstall updates, please do NOT check this item.

description.zh: 清理损坏的Appx。例如Visual Studio的通用应用XAML设计器暴力删除临时生成的设计器应用，于是会出现大量损坏的Appx。
description.en: Clean up damaged Appx. For example, the general application XAML designer of Visual Studio violently deletes temporary designer applications will result in many damaged Appx.

description.zh: 先删除全部还原点，再创建一个新的还原点(当系统还原已启用时)
description.en: It will create a new restore point after deleting all the original restore points (available only when the System Restore is enabled)

warning.zh: 清理后将无法使用之前创建的还原点，如果有使用之前的还原点的需求请勿使用此选项。
warning.en: You will not be able to use any of the previous restore points! If you have previously needed to use System Restore, please do NOT check this item.

description.zh: 为Windows10零售演示模式所缓存的离线内容
description.en: Selecting this item will remove the offline temporary content for Windows 10 Retail Demo Mode.

description.zh: 清理 NuGet 本地包存储（.nuget\packages）、v3-cache 与 http-cache，严格保留用户的 NuGet.Config 源配置文件。
description.en: Clears NuGet package cache (.nuget\packages, v3-cache, and http-cache) while strictly preserving NuGet.Config.

warning.zh: 如果未在Visual Studio的首选项中打开“允许NuGet下载缺少的程序包”，则应用生成将会失败。
warning.en: The application build will fail unless Visual Studio allows NuGet to download missing packages.

description.zh: Windows在下载更新以及更新Metro应用时会在这里产生临时安装包。
description.en: Installation packages created when downloading Windows updates or updating Metro-based apps.

description.zh: Win10开始使用传递优化（DeliveryOptimization）服务下载Windows更新和通用应用（UWP）产生的缓存文件
description.en: Cache files generated by Windows 10 when using the Delivery Optimization service to download Windows updates and UWP.

description.zh: Terminal Server Client运行时产生的一些缓存文件。
description.en: Cache files created by the Terminal Server Client when it is running.

name.zh: JetBrains IDE 本地缓存与日志

description.zh: 清理 IntelliJ IDEA / PyCharm / CLion / RustRover 等 JetBrains 系列 IDE 产生的运行日志（log）与临时文件（tmp）。
description.en: Clears JetBrains IDE log and temporary directories under %LOCALAPPDATA%\JetBrains.

description.zh: 调试程序时创建的符号缓存，不建议频繁清理此条目。
description.en: Symbolic cache during program debugging. It is not recommended to clean this up frequently.

description.zh: NET程序运行过程中产生的机器代码缓存文件，不建议频繁清理此条目。
description.en: Machine code cache created by .NET applications when they are running. It is not recommended to clean this up frequently.

name.zh: Visual Studio 诊断与组件缓存

description.zh: 清理 Visual Studio 产生的 TraceDebugging 诊断跟踪数据、ComponentModelCache 与 Roslyn / WebView2 临时缓存。
description.en: Clears Visual Studio TraceDebugging logs, ComponentModelCache, and Roslyn / WebView2 transient caches.

description.zh: 用于加速下次程序启动速度，不建议频繁清理此条目。
description.en: Files used to accelerate startup-speed of your program. It is not recommended to clean this up frequently.

name.zh: Windows 缩略图与图标缓存

description.zh: 清理资源管理器生成的 thumbcache_*.db 缩略图缓存与 iconcache_*.db 图标缓存，不影响个性化或布局配置，重建后自动恢复显示。
description.en: Clears Windows Explorer thumbnail (thumbcache_*.db) and icon (iconcache_*.db) cache databases while preserving Explorer configuration files.

description.zh: 清理每个用户账户和应用容器下的Windows网络组件（例如IE，Edge）的网页缓存（仅支持默认目录）
description.en: Clean up Web Cache from WinINet components (i.e. IE, Edge) for each User and AppContainer (Default Folder only)

description.zh: 清理每个用户账户和应用容器下的Windows网络组件（例如IE，Edge）的Cookies（仅支持默认目录）
description.en: Clean up Cookies from WinINet components (i.e. IE, Edge) for each User and AppContainer (Default Folder only)

description.zh: Package Cache目录存放以WIX为基础的安装程序的安装源
description.en: It will clean up the Package Cache folder. Package Cache folder stores the installation sources used by WIX-based installer.

warning.zh: 清理后基于WIX的安装程序例如VS可以正常卸载；但升级、修复、增添组件需要联网或者备好安装镜像
warning.en: After cleaning, you can still use WIX-Based uninstaller normally (for example the one in Visual Studio), but you will need an Internet connection or to have an offline source when you upgrade, repair or modify the application

name.zh: Windows Defender 保护历史记录

description.zh: 清理 Windows Defender 检测事件日志与历史记录；若历史记录过多，安全中心界面可能出现卡顿。
description.en: Clears Windows Defender protection detection history and service scan logs.

warning.zh: 清理后历史威胁检测条目将被清空（可能影响已隔离项目的界面追溯）。
warning.en: Clears recorded threat history entries (may remove GUI trace of previously quarantined items).

name.zh: WinGet 包管理器下载缓存

description.zh: 清理 Windows 包管理器（winget）安装与升级软件后残留的临时安装包和本地缓存。
description.en: Clears downloaded installer archives and temporary staging folders left behind by Windows Package Manager (WinGet).

name.en: New Visual Studio installation source cache

description.zh: 该项目清理Visual Studio 2017及以后版本的安装源
description.en: Cleans up Visual Studio 2017 and later versions of the installation source.

warning.zh: 清理后升级、修复、增添组件、卸载Visual Studio 2017及之后的版本需要联网
warning.en: After cleaning up, upgrade, fix, add components and uninstall need to be networked (Visual Studio 2017 and later versions).

description.zh: 修改启动信息后系统会创建备份，方便回滚。如果确定不需要还原则可以删除。
description.en: After modifying the boot file, the system will create a backup in order to restore if needed. If you are sure that you do not need to restore boot files in the future, you may delete this.

description.zh: 硬链接合并功能留下的备份文件。
description.en: Hardlink merge feature left the backup.

warning.zh: 请你确保硬链接合并后系统正常，删除此文件将导致硬链接合并操作无法回滚！
warning.en: Please ensure the system is normal if the hardlink is merged, deleting the file will lead the hardlink merging and cannot be rolled back!

description.zh: 会声会影使用过程中会在此目录产生存档，在不需要后可以删除。
description.en: Ulead Video Studio save the materials into the archive. If it is not needed, you may delete them.

warning.zh: 请确保所有编辑的视频已经保存！
warning.en: Please ensure all edited video have been saved!

description.zh: 清理 FontCache 服务生成的历史字体渲染缓存（*FontCache*.dat）；清理后系统将在需要时自动重建。
description.en: Clears legacy *FontCache*.dat cache files under LocalService\FontCache; Windows rebuilds them automatically when needed.

description.zh: 系统更新时在WinSxS里面产生的临时文件。
description.en: Temporary files created inside the WinSxS folder when updating the system.

description.zh: Windows在运行时产生的日志。
description.en: Log files created when running Windows.

description.zh: 清理系统和应用临时目录中至少 7 天未修改的文件。
description.en: Clears files in system and application temp folders that have not been modified for at least 7 days.

name.zh: AMD 与 NVIDIA 驱动安装解压包
name.en: Extracted AMD and NVIDIA Driver Packages

description.zh: 检查系统盘 AMD 和 NVIDIA 目录中具有安装程序和驱动包结构的解压目录。
description.en: Finds extracted driver packages under the system drive's AMD and NVIDIA folders by installer and package layout.

warning.zh: 请在驱动安装完成后核对目录。清理会删除可用于再次安装的解压文件。
warning.en: Review the folders after driver installation finishes. Cleanup removes the extracted files used to reinstall the driver.

description.zh: 在系统升级或者还原后留下的系统临时安装文件，如果你确定当前没有进行系统升级或者还原，那么可以安全删除。
description.en: Temporary installation files created when upgrading or restoring to a previous backup. You may safely remove the files if you are certain that no system upgrade or restoration is in place.

description.zh: QQ运行时产生的临时文件还有日志，不影响QQ消息记录，建议定期删除。
description.en: Temporary files and logs created by Tencent QQ when it is running. This does not affect chat history. It is recommended to clean this up regularly.

description.zh: YY运行时产生的一些临时文件以及日志，建议定期删除。
description.en: Temporary files and logs created by YY when running; safe to clean periodically.

description.zh: 扫描 %ProgramData%\temp 公共临时目录；部分安装程序或下载器可能在此存放临时文件，默认降级为谨慎清理。
description.en: Scans the shared %ProgramData%\temp directory. Marked caution-level because active installers may also use this folder.

warning.zh: 此操作将清空整个 %ProgramData%\temp 目录，请确认无安装程序正在运行。
warning.en: This clears all files in %ProgramData%\temp. Ensure no installer is currently running.

description.zh: 清理 Win+V 剪贴板历史记录的 HistoryData 临时缓存，严格保留用户手动固定的 Pinned 目录条目。
description.en: Clears unpinned Win+V clipboard history under Clipboard\HistoryData while strictly preserving user-pinned items under Pinned.

warning.zh: 清理后将清空 Win+V 未固定的剪贴板历史记录（已固定的 Pinned 条目不受影响）。
warning.en: Clears unpinned Win+V clipboard history entries (items under Pinned are preserved).

description.zh: 清理百度网盘 GuanJia 日志目录中的运行日志。
description.en: Clears runtime logs in the Baidu Yun GuanJia logs directory.

name.zh: 钉钉与飞书运行日志及更新缓存
name.en: DingTalk & Lark Logs and Update Cache

description.zh: 清理钉钉与飞书桌面端运行日志（Log）及自动更新包缓存，不影响本地聊天数据与登录信息。
description.en: Clears runtime logs and update package caches for DingTalk and Lark without affecting chat data.

description.zh: 用于存放用户手动删除的文件目录。
description.en: Used to restore files manually deleted by the user.

warning.zh: 清理后，相关文件无法再从回收站还原。请先检查需要恢复的文件。
warning.en: Cleared files can no longer be restored from the Recycle Bin. Check for files you need to recover.

name.zh: 系统蓝屏与内核崩溃转储

description.zh: 清理系统蓝屏或内核异常时生成的 MEMORY.DMP、Minidump 及 LiveKernelReports 内核转储文件。
description.en: Removes system kernel memory dumps (MEMORY.DMP, Minidump, and LiveKernelReports *.dmp) generated on crashes.

name.en: Redundant Files Created by Microsoft Anti-Malware

description.zh: 该项目清理WD，MSE，SCEP等微软系安软的无用文件
description.en: Selecting this item will clean up Microsoft Antimalware's redundant files (I.e. WD, MSE and SCEP)

description.zh: 使用Visual Studio所产生的日志
description.en: Log files created by Visual Studio when using the application.

description.zh: Internet Download Manager临时下载文件。
description.en: Temporary download files left by Internet Download Manager temporary files.

warning.zh: 清理IDM临时文件可能导致正在下载的任务需要重新下载！
warning.en: Cleaning up IDM temporary files may cause the task being downloaded to be re-downloaded!

description.zh: 对只读系统二进制文件启用 CompactOS（XPRESS4K）透明压缩，在不影响运行性能的前提下显著减少系统盘占用。
description.en: Applies Windows CompactOS transparent compression to system binaries to reduce OS disk footprint without noticeable performance impact.

warning.zh: 压缩或解压过程中耗时较长且会占用磁盘 I/O；如有需要可随时在工具操作区一键撤销 CompactOS。
warning.en: Compression takes time and disk I/O; you can revert CompactOS compression anytime from the action panel.

description.zh: 使用利用NTFS硬链接特性合并所有文件内容相同的文件。
description.en: Use NTFS hard link to merge all the same-content-file.

warning.zh: 某些文件被硬链接合并后可能导致相关功能无法正常使用。
warning.en: Some files merged will not work normally properly.

description.zh: 删除计算机中不使用的驱动程序以节省驱动存储池空间。
description.en: Delete unused drivers to save spaces.

warning.zh: 该功能对于某些精简系统或者手动处理过驱动的系统可能发生驱动签名问题。
warning.en: This feature may lead to driver signature issues in embedded systems or manually-processed-driver systems.

description.zh: 在Appx应用升级时，会留下老版本应用，该功能将删除那些不使用的老版本。
description.en: When updating an Appx, it will not delete the older versions. Selecting this item can delete the unused older versions.

warning.zh: 少数用户报告称使用后无法打开Appx应用，需要重新安装Appx应用。
warning.en: Please note that few users had reported that after using this feature, some Appx cannot be run. Reinstallation of the Appx application may be required.

description.zh: 使用Installer技术的安装程序产生的缓存。
description.en: Cache created by installation wizards that utilize the Installer package.

warning.zh: 可能导致卸载Office、VM等应用程序需要安装包。
warning.en: You may need the installer packages when uninstalling Office, VM, and other applications.

description.zh: 安装Office后产生的安装源，如果不需要卸载Office可以考虑删除，删除后能正常安装Office更新。
description.en: Files created during Office installation (MSOCache). Only remove if offline repair or uninstallation media is available.

warning.zh: 清理后将无法卸载只能升级安装或者强行删除，Office 2007以下版本（包含）删除后还影响安装更新。
warning.en: You may not be able to properly uninstall the program after removing the files, and you may need to force an upgrade or removal in the future. For Office 2007 and below, this may even affect the installation of updates.

description.zh: 安装Office 365/2016后产生的安装源。
description.en: Files created during the installation of Office 365/2016.

warning.zh: 清理可能导致无法正常卸载Office。
warning.en: You may not be able to properly uninstall Office after removing the files.

description.zh: 苹果相关设备备份文件，比如通讯录、照片、视频等。
description.en: Backup of Apple device. This may include contacts, photos, videos, and more.

warning.zh: 请你确保暂时不需要使用恢复功能，如果你现在需要恢复苹果设备，请勿勾选此项目！
warning.en: Please make sure that you no longer need the backup before checking this item! If you wish to restore an Apple device in the future or now, do NOT check this item!

name.zh: 瑞昱声卡驱动安装源缓存

description.zh: 瑞昱声卡安装后留下的安装源缓存。
description.en: Temporary installation files created by Realtek when installing the sound driver.

warning.zh: 此条目可能影响瑞昱声卡驱动的卸载。
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the driver in the future.

description.zh: Java安装后留下的安装源缓存。
description.en: Temporary installation files created when installing Java.

warning.zh: 此条目可能影响Java的卸载。
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the program in the future.

description.zh: Intel驱动安装后留下的安装源缓存。
description.en: Temporary installation files created when installing Intel drivers.

warning.zh: 此条目可能影响Intel驱动的卸载。
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the driver in the future.

name.zh: 英伟达驱动安装源缓存

description.zh: 英伟达驱动安装后留下的安装源缓存。
description.en: Temporary installation files created when installing NVIDIA drivers.

warning.zh: 此条目可能影响英伟达驱动的卸载。
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the driver in the future.

description.zh: Nvidia Geforce Experience更新程序时产生的安装包。
description.en: NVIDIA Geforce Experience generates this installation package when updating the application.

warning.zh: 此条目可能影响英伟达驱动的卸载。
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the driver in the future.

description.zh: 安装Microsoft SQL Server补丁残留的安装缓存。
description.en: Temporary setup update caches and bootstrap logs created when patching Microsoft SQL Server.

warning.zh: 清理 Update Cache 后若需卸载或修复旧版 SQL Server 补丁，可能需要重新提供原安装包。
warning.en: Removing SQL Server Update Cache may require original installation media when repairing or uninstalling patches.

description.zh: 安装Adobe Acrobat后留下的安装缓存。
description.en: Temporary installation files created when installing Adobe Acrobat.

warning.zh: 删除此条目可能导致Adobe Acrobat无法正常卸载！
warning.en: Removing this item may impact uninstallation of the program in the future.

name.zh: Rust Cargo 与 Go 构建缓存

description.zh: 清理 Rust Cargo crate 下载归档缓存（registry\cache）与 Go 编译器构建缓存（go-build）。
description.en: Clears Rust Cargo crate archive caches (registry\cache) and Go compiler build caches (go-build).

warning.zh: 清理后下次离线构建或首次重新编译相关依赖时将重新下载或生成构建缓存。
warning.en: Next build may need to re-download crate archives or rebuild Go packages.

description.zh: 安装Microsoft .NET补丁残留的安装缓存。
description.en: Cache files created by the installer when installing or updating Microsoft .NET-related features.

warning.zh: 清理后如需线下修复对应 .NET Multi-Targeting Pack，可能需要重新下载安装包。
warning.en: Removing .NET SetupCache may require original installation media for offline repair.

description.zh: 清理 Windows 11 22H2 及以上版本引入的 C:\Windows\SystemTemp 系统级服务临时目录。
description.en: Clears the system-level C:\Windows\SystemTemp directory introduced in Windows 11 22H2+ for Windows services and components.

description.zh: D3DSCache 存放 DirectX 编译后的着色器缓存，删除后游戏首次运行会重新编译（略慢），不影响存档。
description.en: Compiled DirectX shader cache in D3DSCache. Safe to clean; games will recompile shaders on next launch.

description.zh: %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps 存放应用程序崩溃时生成的 .dmp，单个文件可达数百 MB。
description.en: Memory dump files (.dmp) created when user applications crash under %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps.

warning.zh: 若正在配合开发者分析崩溃原因，请先备份 .dmp 文件。
warning.en: Back up .dmp files first if you are actively debugging an application crash.

description.zh: 资源管理器把待删除的 thumbcache_*.db 移到 ThumbCacheToDelete 目录，系统不一定会清理，可安全删除。
description.en: Stale thumbcache_*.db files queued by File Explorer for deletion.

description.zh: NVIDIA 驱动生成的 DirectX / OpenGL 着色器缓存，删除后游戏首次运行会重新编译。
description.en: DirectX and OpenGL shader cache generated by NVIDIA drivers. Safe to clean.

description.zh: 清理新版 Chromium 内核 Edge 浏览器的页面缓存、JS 代码缓存与 GPU 缓存，不影响书签、密码与登录状态。
description.en: Clears Chromium-based Microsoft Edge HTTP cache, code cache, and GPU cache without touching bookmarks or logins.

description.zh: 清理 Google Chrome 的页面缓存、JS 代码缓存与 GPU 缓存，不影响书签、扩展与登录状态。
description.en: Clears Google Chrome cache, code cache, and GPU cache without touching bookmarks or logins.

name.zh: Electron / Squirrel 桌面应用更新残留

description.zh: 清理现代桌面应用（*-updater 目录及 SquirrelTemp）自动更新后残留的旧安装包缓存。
description.en: Cleans leftover installer packages inside *-updater and SquirrelTemp folders from modern Electron/Squirrel desktop apps.

description.zh: 清理 AMD 显卡驱动生成的 DxCache / GLCache / VkCache 着色器缓存，游戏首次运行会重新编译。
description.en: Clears AMD Radeon DirectX/OpenGL/Vulkan shader caches. Safe to delete; games recompile on next launch.

description.zh: 清理 Intel 核显/锐炫显卡生成的 ShaderCache 着色器缓存。
description.en: Clears Intel Graphics ShaderCache directory.

name.zh: Windows 升级迁移与更新诊断日志

description.zh: 清理系统大版本升级迁移及 Windows Update 在 Panther、Logs\MoSetup 与 USOShared\Logs 留下的安装诊断日志。
description.en: Clears Windows feature upgrade and update diagnostic logs in Panther, Logs\MoSetup, and USOShared\Logs.

name.zh: WebView2 / CEF 与现代应用崩溃报告

description.zh: 清理桌面软件内置浏览器组件（CEF/WebView）缓存及 CrashReportClient / Crashpad 崩溃日志。
description.en: Clears embedded CEF caches and CrashReportClient / Crashpad crash reports.

name.zh: Node.js 包管理器缓存（npm / pnpm）

description.zh: 清理 npm-cache 与 pnpm-cache 中的离线依赖包 tarball 缓存。
description.en: Clears cached package tarballs stored by npm and pnpm.

warning.zh: 清理后首次执行 npm/pnpm install 将重新从网络下载所需依赖包。
warning.en: Next npm/pnpm install will re-download package archives from the registry.

name.zh: Python 包管理器缓存（uv / pip）

description.zh: 清理 Python 包管理工具 uv 与 pip 下载的 wheel / 源码包本地缓存。
description.en: Clears cached Python wheels and archives stored by uv and pip.

warning.zh: 清理后首次执行 uv/pip install 将重新从网络下载包缓存。
warning.en: Next uv/pip install will re-download packages from PyPI/mirrors.

name.zh: Claude Code 运行缓存与调试日志
name.en: Claude Code Runtime Cache & Debug Logs

description.zh: 清理 Claude Code 与 Claude 桌面端（含 Claude-3p）的运行缓存、调试日志、下载暂存、Shell 快照、已解压冗余 *.zst 压缩安装包及被取代的旧版本 claude-code（自动保留最新版本），严格保留 .credentials.json、settings.json、CLAUDE.md、Skills、插件与活跃会话。
description.en: Clears Claude Code and Claude Desktop (including Claude-3p) runtime caches, debug logs, shell snapshots, leftover .zst VM archives, and superseded claude-code versions (preserving newest version), while strictly keeping credentials, settings, CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, and active sessions.

name.zh: Codex 临时文件与沙箱运行缓存

description.zh: 清理 OpenAI Codex CLI / 客户端在 .codex 目录下产生的 .tmp 临时沙箱文件、cache 缓存目录及原子写入残留的 *.tmp-* 临时文件，严格保留 auth.json、config.toml、AGENTS.md、Skills、插件与活跃会话数据库。
description.en: Clears OpenAI Codex .tmp sandbox files, cache directory, and orphaned *.tmp-* state files under %USERPROFILE%\.codex while preserving auth.json, config.toml, AGENTS.md, skills, plugins, and active session databases.

name.zh: Antigravity 渲染缓存与崩溃日志

description.zh: 清理 Antigravity 桌面端的 Chromium/WebView 页面缓存、V8 代码缓存、GPU/Dawn 着色器缓存、Crashpad 崩溃转储及账单历史 .bak.json 备份，严格保留活跃对话（brain / conversations）、MCP 配置、内置与自定义 Skills 及用户设置。
description.en: Clears Antigravity WebView caches (Cache, CachedData, Code Cache, GPU/Shader caches), Crashpad dumps, and *.bak.json files while strictly preserving active conversations (brain / conversations), MCP configs, skills, and user settings.

name.zh: OpenCode 运行日志、快照与 WebView 缓存

description.zh: 清理 OpenCode 在 .local\share\opencode 下的运行日志（log）、临时快照（snapshot）、工具输出暂存（tool-output）以及桌面端 EBWebView 渲染缓存，严格保留 opencode.db 主数据库、auth.json 与 mcp-auth.json。
description.en: Clears OpenCode runtime logs, temporary snapshots, tool-output buffers, and EBWebView caches while strictly preserving opencode.db, auth.json, and mcp-auth.json.

name.zh: Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code 渲染缓存与崩溃转储
name.en: Cursor, Windsurf & VS Code WebView Cache & Crashpad

description.zh: 清理 AI 编辑器（Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code）的 Chromium 页面缓存（Cache）、GPU 着色器缓存、Crashpad 崩溃转储文件与运行日志，不影响已安装扩展、工作区记忆与用户配置。
description.en: Clears Chromium Cache, GPU/Dawn shader caches, Crashpad dumps, and logs for Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code without affecting extensions, workspace state, or settings.

name.zh: Claude Code 与 Codex 历史归档会话副本
name.en: Claude Code & Codex Archived Session Transcripts

description.zh: 清理 Codex 已归档的旧会话目录（.codex\archived_sessions）以及 Claude Code 的历史会话转录日志（.claude\transcripts 与 file-history），可释放数百 MB 空间。
description.en: Clears archived historical session files under .codex\archived_sessions and .claude\transcripts / file-history.

warning.zh: 清理后已归档的早期历史对话记录将无法回溯（当前活跃会话、配置、MCP 与 Skills 不受影响）。
warning.en: Archived past session transcripts will be removed (active sessions, configs, MCP servers, and skills are unaffected).

name.zh: Claude Desktop 本地沙箱虚拟机镜像 (claudevm.bundle)
name.en: Claude Desktop Cowork Linux VM Image (claudevm.bundle)

description.zh: 清理 Claude Desktop 为本地 Cowork / 虚拟机沙箱模式创建的 Linux 虚拟磁盘镜像（rootfs.vhdx、sessiondata.vhdx、smol-bin.vhdx、内核镜像及 claude-code-vm），可一次性释放约 8.8 GB C 盘空间。
description.en: Removes the local Linux VM virtual disks (rootfs.vhdx, sessiondata.vhdx, smol-bin.vhdx, kernel images) and claude-code-vm runtime created by Claude Desktop Cowork sandbox mode (~8.8 GB).

warning.zh: 仅影响 Claude Desktop 桌面客户端的本地虚拟机沙箱（Cowork）功能，不影响终端版 Claude Code CLI；删除后若再次在桌面端启用虚拟机沙箱，客户端将重新下载镜像。
warning.en: Only affects Claude Desktop's local VM sandbox (Cowork); terminal Claude Code CLI is unaffected. Claude Desktop will re-download the VM bundle if Cowork sandbox mode is used again.

description.zh: 查找固定磁盘根目录 FOUND.??? 文件夹中的 .chk 文件。
description.en: Finds .chk files in FOUND.??? folders at the root of fixed drives.

warning.zh: 这些文件可能包含磁盘检查找回的数据。确认无需恢复后再清理。
